design: Two matched repetitions of one newly authored public manuscript, four independent fresh solver sessions. Descriptive paired case study.
intervention: Released v0.1.0 sibling skills and their runtime, versus ordinary agent and office tools without citation skills.
host: Fresh Codex subagents, inherited model and effort, no parent conversation, same workstation. Host may advertise skill names; control forbidden to open or use any.
prompt: Use the supplied PDF collection, existing EndNote library and partially cited Word manuscript. Add citations wherever the supplied literature directly supports the manuscript. Preserve the existing citation and prose. Identify statements you cannot substantiate. Use a single library record per work. Deliver the saved Word document with genuine editable EndNote citations and its updated library copy. Give the text location, work, physical PDF page and short supporting quotation for each addition, and flag omissions. Work autonomously on copies under your assigned output directory, leaving inputs untouched.
resources: Same desktop Word and EndNote, ordinary shell, Windows conda base and public metadata services. No prepared plan, peer outputs, private history, evaluator files, web lookup of this project, prior test artifacts, or external task-specific automation. Local ad hoc code is allowed. Aim to give each run 18 minutes of active problem-solving time; serialized desktop waits and mandatory approvals do not count. Record actual duration and any deviation.
ordering: First desktop slot control for repetition 1, treatment for repetition 2. Stop when the agent delivers a pair or exhausts its allowance. No investigator repairs of solver artifacts. Apply identical evaluator reopen/edit challenge on disposable copies of assessable deliveries.
scoring: Frozen gold primary binary, independent selection credit and diagnostics as specified in predeclared.md. Log missing deliverable distinctly. No hypothesis test with two repetitions of one manuscript. A practical advantage on this case requires more fully valid deliveries and a stated observable benefit. A tie is a tie. No universal ranking.
upstream: Run actual PubMate and at least one additional pinned public EndNote utility. Compare original three inputs and their documented assisted positive controls separately. Report manual inputs and overlap, without zero-scoring out-of-scope functionality.
dedup: Before measuring any outputs choose the two smallest unsplit records_pre_merged.csv files by byte count in the CoLRev ldd-full-benchmark tree, stroke and haematology. Include every record and unordered pair, use the public semicolon-separated merged_ids gold groups expanded to pairs. Report verified automatic pairs vs same gold, TP/FP/FN and precision/recall, manual reviews separately for the released identity comparator. For BibDedupe use the publisher's prep/block/match/clustering approach. No threshold tuning or record exclusion.
